entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: The Green-aligned praetor of New Phyrexia and apex predator of the Vicious Swarm.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian plane ruled by the praetors.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: A compleated elf who serves Vorinclex.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Praetor who took over New Phyrexia and manipulates Vorinclex.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: Planeswalker infected by Vorinclex and forced to cause a distraction.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker who fights Vorinclex with the Omenseekers.

entities.name: Esika
entities.description: Mauled by Vorinclex in her sanctum.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: Compleated ally of Phyrexia who puts Nissa on the run.

events.summary: Vorinclex is sent to Kaldheim through the Planar Bridge on Norn's orders; the process destroys his body and he rebuilds himself.
events.quote: Vorinclex was sent to Kaldheim through the Planar Bridge on Norn's orders.

events.summary: Vorinclex infects Tibalt, forcing him to cause a distraction in exchange for an antidote.
events.quote: he ambushed the planeswalker Tibalt and infected him

events.summary: Kaya and the Omenseekers fight Vorinclex; Alrund reveals himself and the praetor flees.
events.quote: The god Alrund revealed himself, too disgusted at Vorinclex, and the praetor fled

events.summary: Vorinclex mauls Esika to near death, takes a tyrite sample and returns to New Phyrexia.
events.quote: Vorinclex invaded the sanctum of Esika and mauled her to near death.

events.summary: Lukka and Nissa attack Vorinclex and Glissa in the Hunter Maze; Nissa wounds Vorinclex and a compleated Lukka puts her on the run.
events.quote: Vorinclex was severely wounded by Nissa, but a compleated Lukka put Nissa on the run

events.summary: Elesh Norn breaks off one of Vorinclex's horns to throw at Elspeth Tirel.
events.quote: Elesh Norn in despair broke off one of Vorinclex's horns to throw it at the archangel planeswalker.

events.summary: Vorinclex meets the invaders head-on when Zhalfir is switched with New Phyrexia and may be killed.
events.quote: his ultimate fate remains to be seen.

relations.quote: Elesh Norn was able to manipulate him easily once she took over New Phyrexia.
compleated many elves — Glissa among them
Vorinclex was severely wounded by Nissa
